A-15.eligibility: Normal permanent single-family residence/residential farm; not construction service.

B-16.billing_demand: Maximum metered fifteen-minute kW in billing month. RKVA may be measured and billed separately.
B-16.minimum: Highest of basic customer charge; tariff demand charge applied to greater of half preceding-calendar-year highest monthly billing demand and half requested capacity; or contract minimum. Exact minimum application requires independent account review.
B-16.eligibility: General/non-residential secondary service; customers qualifying for LPD-2 must take LPD-2/successor. No eligibility inferred from modeled imports.

B-15.note: Historical observation only; B-16 is the current catalog ID. STS-12 names B-14 rather than this successor.

cooperative_tax_factor.rule: For qualifying federal-entity power purchases, deduct from each tax amount under A(1), A(2) and A(3) that amount times total federal power cost, including facilities rental, divided by total cooperative Virginia operating revenue for the taxable period.
cooperative_tax_factor.gap: SVEC-specific dated utility-period federal-power ratio or independently established statutory nonapplicability is absent. A hypothetical account checkbox or generic ordinary-tax confirmation cannot establish a zero ratio.
cooperative_tax_factor.locality_scope_considered: Unincorporated Rockingham County; complete effective local utility-tax vector and source reconciliation not established by this adapter.

billing_chronology.current_base: Effective for bills rendered on/after May 1, 2026; seasons are June-September versus October-May billing months.
billing_chronology.pca: Website factors explicitly labeled by billing month; unsupported factors are not filled from a neighboring month.
billing_chronology.terms: Monthly bills; start/end service prorated by days; estimates permitted if no valid reading. Tariffs allow readings billed in units of 10 kWh, requiring independent meter precision before future acceptance.

DER_scope.required: Final written exact-installation permission for parallel operation, active interconnection/metering before cycle, ordinary import terms and all extra charges. Terms 2026 printed p.5 provides approval requirement.
DER_scope.storage: PV-only charging and zero export; no standalone or grid-charged storage evidence.
DER_scope.settlement: No export credits, net metering or demand/credit state is enabled.
